decisions.reason: The award-winning yogurt on fruit puree sits in the firm's core organic dairy offer and showed results above aspiration, so there is no shortfall to trigger search, though the lack of mention since 2018 adds some uncertainty.
The semi-hard cheese wheel uses existing milk supply and processes at low cost, and with no evidence of a shortfall it is likely kept.
The spicy cheese line may lose single variants, as its sibling flavoured cheese B was dropped, but the line as a whole is likely carried while slack from a growing industry allows it.
The mild creamy soft cheese rounds out the cheese range, and unlike the dropped washed-rind soft cheese there is no sign it falls short of aspiration, so management keeps it.
